Mississippi State Senate
2026 Regular Session
YEAS AND NAYS On H. B. No. 4033. On motion of Senator Whaley, the rules
were suspended, the bill considered engrossed, read the third time and, the yeas and
nays being taken, it failed to pass as amended, title standing as stated, by the following
vote, a three-fifths vote being required:
Yeas--Barnett, Blackmon, Blackwell, Blount, Boyd, Carter, Chassaniol, Chism,
DeBar, Fillingane, Harkins, Hartness, Hill, Kirby, Ladner, McCaughn, McLendon,
McMahan, Parks, Rhodes, Seymour, Simmons D. T. (12th), Sparks, Suber, Taylor,
Thompson, Whaley, Wiggins, Williams, Younger. Total--30.
Nays--Barrett, Berry, Brumfield, Bryan, Butler, DeLano, DuPree, England,
Frazier, Gillespie Isom, Hickman, Jackson, Johnson, Michel, Mumford, Norwood, Pope,
Simmons S. (13th), Tate, Thomas, Turner-Ford. Total--21.
Absent and those not voting----None.
Voting Present--Hopson. Total--1.
